## Toolbelt culture checks

- [ ] Does **not** treat `draft` / `proposed` research, design, or plans as accepted SoT
- [ ] Cite-or-omit respected if this adds factual claims
- [ ] If **skills/rules**: used Theme 4 / `author-cursor-surfaces` patterns (`name` == folder, domain-first id, Handoffs, no pasted pocket law)
- [ ] If **skills/templates/PROTOCOL**: noted `refresh-skill-references` + `sync-toolbelt-local-plugin` + Reload for reviewers
- [ ] Domain-first naming respected for any new skill id
